papers.title: Onion Johnny's note
lines: Three hundred strings of pink onions on the bicycle, and a beret, and a boat to Plymouth.
The English call me Johnny. I call them madame. We understand each other perfectly.

papers.title: Flag-maker's card
lines: The Breton flag has nine black and white stripes and a field of ermine. Nobody can remember why, but everybody loves it.
Mind the ermine. They have a way of looking indignant.

papers.title: Crêperie scrap
lines: A galette of buckwheat, ham, egg and cheese, with cider in a bowl.
Ask for a bolée. A glass would be a polite insult.

papers.title: Lighthouse log
lines: Fog all night. The horn blew every two minutes and the gulls lodged a complaint.
At dawn the fog lifted and a Breton fishing boat was ten feet away. We waved. They waved. Neither will mention it.
